google.hint: Open your Google Business Profile, choose Get more reviews, and copy the link. The wording of these buttons may change. Paste it here and the QR code opens your review box.

instagram.subline: We share new offers and updates there
instagram.caption: Follow on Instagram
instagram.hint: Type your handle, like @mycafe, or paste your profile link. People who scan it land on your profile.

facebook.label: Facebook follow or review
facebook.headline: Find us on Facebook
facebook.scanLabel: Scan to follow or review us
facebook.subline: Like our page for updates and offers
facebook.caption: Follow on Facebook
facebook.hint: Type your page name, like @mycafe, or paste your page link. Open it in the app, tap Share and copy the link. The wording of these buttons may change.

youtube.label: YouTube subscribe
youtube.headline: Subscribe on YouTube
youtube.caption: Subscribe on YouTube
youtube.hint: Type your channel handle, like @mychannel, or paste your channel link.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp chat
whatsapp.headline: Chat with us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.caption: Message on WhatsApp
whatsapp.hint: Type your WhatsApp number. Ten digits are treated as an Indian number, or add the country code. People who scan it open a chat with you.
